text: Alsulaiman Group traces its foundations to Abdullah Bin Sulaiman Al-Hamdan, and says his legacy has been carried forward by his family.
short: Alsulaiman Group is an Alsulaiman-family group.

source.name: Alsulaiman Group – Sheikh Abdullah Bin Sulaiman Al-Hamdan
source.quote: His dedication and dreams have since been carried forward by his family, as they embrace his legacy and vision.
